CommunityApplications.Profile:
GarageStack is an open-source, self-hosted dashboard for MG / SAIC electric, plug-in hybrid and hybrid cars. It connects to the MG iSmart cloud and stores all data locally in a single container: no external database or MQTT broker required.
Features: a live dashboard and remote commands, climate and charging schedules, energy, fuel and efficiency statistics over any period, a trip log with automatic commutes and CSV export, maintenance reminders, a map with trip history, heatmaps and OpenStreetMap overlays (including speed cameras), push notifications, single sign-on, and Home Assistant integration.
Support: https://github.com/joszz/garagestack/issues
